title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Sheshi Skënderbej, Tiranë (ID: 530191070-31)
description_sq:
Duplex per shitje , ne qender te Tiranes.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes, ne fillim te Rruges se Kavajes. Ndodhet ne katin e 10 teknik ,te nje pallati te mire administruar me 2 ashensor.
Mundesi e shkelqyer investimi , pasi ambjenti eshte i dhene me qira per zyra , dhe gjeneron te ardhura te qendrueshme mujore. ideale si per perdorim te menjehershem , ashtu edhe per investim afatgjate.
Zona ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode : transport publik, shkolla , banka , markete e cdo sherbim te nevojshem. Ambjenti eshte aktualisht i perdorur si zyra , por mund te pershtatet lehtesisht per banim familjar.
title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Skënderbej Square, Tirana (ID: 530191070-31)
description_en: Duplex for sale, in the center of Tirana. The apartment is located in one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana, at the beginning of Kavaje Street. It is located on the 10th technical floor of a well-managed building with 2 elevators. Excellent investment opportunity, as the space is rented for offices, and generates stable monthly income. ideal for both immediate use and long-term investment. The area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life: public transport, schools, banks, markets and every necessary service. The space is currently used as an office, but can easily be adapted for family living.
